work_or_witness: Legend of the Five Rings Roleplaying Core Rulebook · Core Rulebook: Honor is Stronger than Steel
definition: The named fictional setting and imperial political frame for the selected FFG roleplaying core book.
cultural_caution: A fictional world with a Japanese-language and samurai-era-inflected design, not historical Japan or a representation of any real Japanese, Asian, religious, or cultural community.

citations.locator: Core Rulebook: Honor is Stronger than Steel
supports: Edge identifies Rokugan and the Emerald Empire as the core book's setting frame.

work_or_witness: Legend of the Five Rings Roleplaying Core Rulebook · Core Rulebook setting description: duty in service to lord, Clan, and Emperor
definition: The fictional player-character service role in the Emerald Empire, tied in the core product's description to lord, Clan, and Emperor.
cultural_caution: Rokugan's role is a fictional game construct using a Japanese-derived term. It is not an exact representation of historical Japanese samurai, feudal hierarchy, or any present-day Japanese identity.

citations.locator: Core Rulebook setting description: duty in service to lord, Clan, and Emperor
supports: Edge describes player samurai's fictional service relationship in the Emerald Empire.

work_or_witness: Legend of the Five Rings Roleplaying Core Rulebook · Enter Rokugan: Emerald Empire and seven Great Clans
definition: The major fictional political/military affiliations described as protecting and dividing the Emerald Empire.
cultural_caution: A setting-specific institution, not a representation of real clans, family systems, ethnicity, social class, or political affiliation. Specific clan claims need their own exact witness.

citations.locator: Enter Rokugan: Emerald Empire and seven Great Clans
supports: Fantasy Flight describes the Empire as divided by seven Great Clans.

work_or_witness: Legend of the Five Rings · The Role of the Five Rings
definition: The selected FFG RPG's five core attributes, designed to express different approaches to problem-solving through the Five Rings.
cultural_caution: Edition-specific game mechanics. They should not be treated as direct equivalents of real-world elemental traditions, personality typologies, spiritual systems, or the card game's rules.

citations.locator: The Role of the Five Rings
supports: Fantasy Flight identifies Ring Values as a new RPG core system and says it diverges from predecessors and Genesys.

work_or_witness: Legend of the Five Rings · Craft Your Story: Game of 20 Questions
definition: The core character-creation procedure used to establish a player samurai's mechanical and narrative place in Rokugan.
cultural_caution: A player-authorship tool. Answers create a campaign character rather than proving canonical biography, lineage, honor, desire, or duty for any named person in the setting.

citations.locator: Craft Your Story: Game of 20 Questions
supports: Fantasy Flight describes the procedure as helping players establish a complex character thematically and mechanically.
